prompt: The image is rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, capturing the intricate interior of a botanical greenhouse. In the center stands a tall glass pane reflecting the sky. To the left, a woman in a blue coat holds a watering can. Next to her, a small potted fern sits on a wooden bench. A man in a red scarf points at the fern while standing beside the woman. Above them, a hanging basket of ivy dangles from the ceiling beams. On the right, a child in a yellow hat looks up at the ivy. Beside the child, a brown dog sits patiently on the tiled floor. Behind the dog, an elderly man in a tweed cap leans on a cane. Near the cane, a pair of gardening gloves rests on a low shelf. In the foreground, a large monstera leaf dominates the lower view. Perched on the monstera, a green parrot preens its feathers. Looking at the parrot, a girl in pink overalls reaches out a hand. Holding the girl’s shoulder, her mother in a floral dress smiles gently. Further back, a stone statue of a cherub stands near a pillar. Resting on the cherub’s head, a small sparrow pecks at crumbs. Next to the statue, a terracotta pot lies tipped on its side. Spilling from the pot, dark soil spreads across the tiles. Watching the spill, a gardener in denim overalls kneels down. Holding a trowel, the gardener begins to scoop the dirt. Above the gardener, a skylight allows soft daylight to filter in. Attached to the skylight frame, a cobweb glistens faintly. Near the web, a spider waits motionless in the corner. Observing the spider, a cat with white paws crouches low. Chasing the cat, a mouse scurries behind a crate. Hidden inside the crate, several seed packets are stacked neatly. Leaning against the crate, a bamboo stake supports a young vine. Twining around the stake, the vine displays fresh green buds. Smelling the buds, a bee hovers mid-air nearby. There is no electric lighting fixture visible in the scene. There is no modern plastic furniture present anywhere. There is no digital signage or screen displayed.
